items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I have to give you my in, in that a fellow named Bob Jacobson wrote an article about you. [INTERVIEWEE] He did. He’s from Providence.

ctx.x: I don’t even remember, who do you like singing it? Because who had the big hit on it? I don’t even know.
